items.title: Family Of 4 Dies In Rogers Park Fire: ‘Devastating Tragedy’
items.description: Two sons, their mother and their grandmother were killed in the fire early Thursday morning. The family dog also died in the blaze.

items.title: Nonstop Christmas Music Returns Thursday To 93.9 LITE FM
items.description: Around-the-clock holiday music kicks off at 3 p.m Thursday. In recent years, the station has begun playing Christmas tunes on or around Nov. 1.

items.title: Proposed Smoke Shop Isn’t Fit For Wells Street, Old Town Neighbors And Alderman Say
items.description: Ald. Brian Hopkins and a local business group are urging the city to reject the license applications for Exotic Corner, which they say put up large signage and started construction without notice.

items.title: From Station Stoves To Overhead Heat: The History Of The CTA’s Warming Lamps
items.description: The electric, infrared heat lamps in over 120 CTA locations are among Chicago's favorite amenities. They're officially on for the season.

items.title: This Southeast Side Park Needs A Name, And Neighbors Can Weigh In
items.description: The Steelworkers Park Advisory Council is collecting name suggestions through Dec. 31 for Park 566 on the former U.S. Steel South Works site, now a popular birding spot.

items.title: Edgewater Neighbors Appeal Judge’s Broadway Upzoning Ruling
items.description: The plaintiffs are asking for a judge's move to throw out their case be overturned, saying it ignored decades of Illinois zoning law.

items.title: 21 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: South Side Health And Wellness Fest, Fall Fun And More
items.description: There's also vintage fests, a pumpkin smash, Día de los Muertos celebrations, a dim sum drag brunch and more to check out.

items.title: Beverly Phono Mart Makes Pop-Up Space Permanent After Car Crashed Into Original Location
items.description: Mallory McClaire and Chantala Kommanivanh moved their record shop to a temporary storefront on 103rd, and they’ve decided to stay. Their grand reopening is Saturday.
